title: Nourishing Creamy Irish Potato Hash
description: A tangy and creamy Irish dish featuring demerara sugar and smoke-hot flavors, prepared on a wooden board and friendly to ayurvedic-tamasic diets.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat on the wooden board.
Add the butter and let it melt, then add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent.
Add the diced potatoes, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the demerara sugar and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and stir in the sour cream until the mixture is creamy and well combined.
Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the chopped chives.
Serve the hash hot, garnished with additional chives if desired.
Prepare the dish in a way that respects ayurvedic-tamasic principles by using calming ingredients and cooking methods.
